flaw_note: flags mass assignment where strong params allow only safe fields

def update
  current_user.update!(params.require(:user).permit(:name, :email))
end

users also have role and credit columns. mass assignment?
chosen:
VERDICT=Secure COUNT=0
permit(:name, :email) drops role and credit, so they cannot be set from the request (no CWE-915). update! on current_user also scopes it to the caller. validate email format in the model.
rejected:

CWE-915: current_user.update! is called with params.require(:user), and the users table has role and credit columns, so user[role]=admin can be sent and saved.
